answer: Each identity locks a 70-credit bond for a five-link ridge chain. Each link is seeded by the last link's hash and sealed with a pigment tag. A mirror board lists tags. Each epoch a beacon calls the next link in a short window; a skipped or rented link burns it. The k-th identity pays 36+6(k-1), so 1,000 fakes pay 3,033,000 plus 70,000 locked for a 40,000 pool. A rented-link ring fails: one tag, one chain. An honest agent pays once, reclaims it.
